svg.title: Thai Nguyen · the trust line
svg.desc: A financial product is only as strong as the trust behind it. Thai Nguyen, Senior Product Owner at Zalopay, moved from merchant payments to onboarding, identity (VNeID eKYC), the 12-person User Core team he led (login, anti-fraud) and Buy Now Pay Later credit. Next stop: Singapore.
svg.text: THAI NGUYEN · SENIOR PRODUCT OWNER, ZALOPAY

g.text: A financial product is only as strong

svg.text: Three years building the trust layer of Zalopay, one team at a time.
The rule is not the obstacle. It is the rail.
Next station: Singapore. Please mind the platform gap.
